Layout Properties

The code on the rest of my site can be a bit messy, but with these templates I try to behave myself and follow best practices.

All layouts are responsive to screen size. I test them on my small laptop, my phone, and my ultrawide desktop monitor in both firefox and a chromium browser. I don't test in safari, because I don't own any apple devices.

Templates use semantic HTML wherever possible and include a few comments in the code to help orient you. They do not include the placeholder images shown in the previews.

Terms of Use

You may:

  • Change colors, fonts, margins, etc (please do! change it all and make it yours!)
  • Move the credit from its default location
  • Remove the credit entirely (I think it's worthwhile to cite your sources, but I won't come nag you about it)
  • Let me know if something is broken
  • Break it yourself

You may not:

  • Redistribute these for commercial purposes
  • Expect 24/7 tech support

Layout #3: Cyanobacteria

  • Release date: March 9, 2024
  • Inspiration: any of the top sites on neocities or nekoweb, MagicPattern

I wanted to try making one of those 2000s-style “everything in tiny boxes” homepage layouts with some modern improvements. The container width is set in rem (so the box scales with each visitor's default font size) and it's a flexbox (so the tiny boxes get rearranged responsively). Light and dark mode are included, with colors set by the variables at the top of the CSS file.
